bleeding.name: Bleeding
bleeding.system.description: Take 3 pure damage at the start of your turn for each stack of Bleeding. Stacks up to 5 times. Removed by the @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.Enl336RoHnl7foYR]{Interact} maneuver with a Healing check, or by any healing effect.

blind.name: Blinded
blind.system.description: The creature is blinded: −4 to melee attacks; −8 to ranged and magical attacks; −4 to Block and Dodge.

burning.name: Burning
burning.system.description:
Take 3 fire damage at the start of your turn for each stack of Burning. Stacks up to 5 times. Lasts 3 rounds; new stacks reset the timer.
Removed by @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.Enl336RoHnl7foYR]{Interact}

clinch.name: In Clinch
clinch.system.description:
1. If you try to move away from an opponent you are in a clinch with, they can make an Attack of Opportunity reaction.

2. Shooting into a clinch is difficult: the condition gives shooters a -2 penalty (on a critical fumble, the shot hits an ally).

3. If you choose to make an Attack of Opportunity against a character crossing your Control Zone, you are considered to leave the Clinch with your current opponent, and they can make an Attack of Opportunity against you.

4. Characters In Clinch can be targeted by the @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.Y8Eh46LmqB2MOoCl]{Flank Attack} maneuver.

disoriented.name: Disoriented
disoriented.system.description:
Lasts 1 round. Stacks. At three stacks it turns into Stunned.

Penalty: all maneuvers cost +1 AP per stack.

dying.name: Dying
dying.system.description:
You can spend 1 Luck Point to remove this condition.
Another character can use @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.Enl336RoHnl7foYR]{Interact} and a Healing check to remove this condition.
A Potion of Healing or any ability that restores HP removes this condition.
After the first Dying condition in a session, the character gains the @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.conditions.Item.jDf1KR27t0mPAAlj]{Fatigued} condition; after the second, the @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.conditions.Item.gvltC2kWle3yTOyx]{Exhausted} condition.

entangled.name: Entangled
entangled.system.description:
Effect: the target cannot Dodge at all, only Block, and its Speed drops to 0. Lasts 1 round, not a single attack.

Sources: magic (Hydromancy, Path of Ice: the Constraint modifier at rank 3, DC 14; the Forbid Defense modifier at rank 4 with Dodge chosen), web grenades, entangling exotic weapons: net, bola, sasumata (WIP).

Difference from @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.conditions.Item.ConditionPressed]{Pressed}: Pressed is applied by ordinary weapons, lasts for one attack against the target, and doesn't affect Speed. Entangled is the hard version: a whole round with no Dodge and no movement, which is why only magic and special gear can apply it.

Not automated: the GM enforces the Dodge ban and zero Speed manually (on NPCs, a manual speed override beats effects).

exhausted.name: Exhausted
exhausted.system.description:
Cannot take an active part in combat: the only maneuver available is @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.Enl336RoHnl7foYR]{Interact}. Movement is still allowed: it is not a maneuver and costs no AP.

NOT AUTOMATED

false_life.name: False Life
false_life.system.description:
Someone else's dead flesh is in the body: the wounds have closed over in gray, and the seams don't match in color.

Effect: the bearer cannot regain HP by any means: not by Biomancy, potions, a Healing check, or rest. They look like a walking corpse: ashen skin, the smell of decay.

Removal: cut open the seams (Interact with a Healing check), which removes the temporary HP entirely; or when the temporary HP run out; or on a Long Rest.

Source: Shadowmancy, the False Life Long Cast.

Not automated: the GM enforces the healing ban.

fatigued.name: Fatigued
fatigued.system.description:
The character takes a -5 penalty to all rolls.

Removed by rest, potions, or spells.

fear.name: Fear
fear.system.description:
The condition lasts two turns and does not stack.

The character takes -2 to skill checks.

frenzy.name: Frenzy
frenzy.system.description:
Effect: the creature ignores wound penalties to rolls: the wound track is still kept, but it doesn't hinder rolls.

The cost. A frenzied creature doesn't tell friend from foe: the GM may turn its attack against an ally if the ally is closer or struck last. Tactics vanish; all that remains is the nearest living thing.

Removal: by the specific creature's trigger (for the Matriarch, acid damage), or at the GM's discretion. It does not wear off on its own.

The condition is neutral rather than negative: it both empowers and takes away control. Applied manually from the token HUD.

full_paralysis.name: Full Paralysis
full_paralysis.system.description:
Duration depends on the source; 3 rounds by default.

Completely unable to act: falls prone or stands frozen in place.

Removed when the duration ends, or by potions or spells.

NOT AUTOMATED

grappled.name: Grappled
grappled.system.description:
Effect: Speed 0, −2 to Dodge. Unlike the Entangled condition, you can still Dodge, just worse.

The condition is mutual: the grappler is bound just as much and takes the same penalty, so apply Grappled to both participants.

The grapple holds as long as both are alive and conscious: leaving your square means letting go.

Removal: @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.Enl336RoHnl7foYR]{Interact} with an Athletics contest against the opponent's Athletics (+2 per size category of difference in favor of the larger one). Success removes the condition from both.

The Dodge penalty is automated. The GM enforces zero Speed manually: on NPCs, a manual speed override beats effects.

knockout.name: Knockout
knockout.system.description:
The character can no longer act and falls prone.
Removal: a Constitution saving throw at the start of the turn to come to (DC 12), potions, or @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.Enl336RoHnl7foYR]{Interact} (healing).

NOT AUTOMATED

off_guard.name: Off Guard
off_guard.system.description:
Effect: the target cannot Block against the next attack and defends with Dodge only. Anyone can make that attack, not just whoever applied the condition.

Applied by: @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.8mgcq7OFtffV34Jw]{Feint} (Deception against Insight, Fast weapon) and @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.kHwErvUQ3caABupP]{Sunder Block} (an axe or falchion attack against Athletics).

Removal: by the very first attack against the target, hit or miss, or at the end of the round.

Why it matters. A target defends with the highest applicable value, so the ban drops a blocker onto their secondary Dodge and zeroes out everything they invested in Block: shield, stances, bonuses. It pairs with the @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.conditions.Item.ConditionPressed]{Pressed} condition, which breaks a dodger in exactly the same way.

Not automated: enforced at the table; the maneuver card shows a Forbidden Defense badge.

pain.name: Pain
pain.system.description: Penalty: all actions cost 1 AP more per stack of Pain.

partial_paralysis.name: Partial Paralysis
partial_paralysis.system.description:
• Effect: The affected limbs don't function (arms, legs, wings).

  • Removal: Depends on the source.

  • Duration: Depends on the source; 3 rounds by default.

Penalties are situational, at the GM's discretion.

poison_combat.name: Poisoned (Combat)
poison_combat.system.description:
Effect: at the end of its turn the bearer takes (stacks)d4 damage. The damage can't be resisted: poison is not a damage type but a save axis, so neither DR nor elemental resistance reduces it.

Stacks. Stacks like Bleeding, capped at 3. A new stack resets the full duration.

Duration: 3 rounds from the last stack.

Removal: an antidote, Biomancy healing magic, or expiry. The saving throw is made on hit, not every turn: a creature that resists isn't poisoned at all.

This is a chassis, not a named poison. Specific poisons are consumable items that apply this condition; the save DC comes from the source (for creatures, 9 + Threat Rank; for crafted poisons, by rarity).

pressed.name: Pressed
pressed.system.description:
Effect: the target cannot Dodge against the next attack and defends with Block only. Anyone can make that attack, not just whoever applied the condition.

Speed is unaffected: the target hasn't been hurt; it has just been left no room to step off the line. That is what sets Pressed apart from @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.conditions.Item.4SJa3sjExOBaK6g1]{Entangled}, the hard version from magic and entangling gear (a full-round ban plus Speed 0).

Applied by: Overwhelming Strike (bludgeoning and two-handed weapons), Drive Back (shield or a second weapon), Corner (target with its back to an obstacle).

Removal: by the very first attack against the target, hit or miss, or at the end of the round.

Why it matters. A target defends with the highest applicable value, so the ban drops a dodger onto their secondary Block and zeroes out everything they invested in Dodge, including reaction bonuses such as Volt Step. It pairs with the Off Guard condition, which breaks a blocker in exactly the same way.

Not automated: enforced at the table; the maneuver card shows a Forbidden Defense badge.

prone.name: Prone
prone.system.description:
Effect: +2 to Dodge against ranged attacks, -2 to Block and Dodge against melee attacks.

Removal: @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.Enl336RoHnl7foYR]{Interact} (stand up)

NOT AUTOMATED.

stunned.name: Stunned
stunned.system.description:
Effect: At most one maneuver per round, and maneuvers cost 3 AP more.

Removal: When the duration ends, potions, spells

Duration: until the start of the next turn.

NOT AUTOMATED

suffocating.name: Suffocating
suffocating.system.description:
Effect: A cumulative -1 penalty to all rolls for each round spent in this condition. At ten stacks: @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.conditions.Item.krX0myh7VFC4yKvJ]{Knockout}
Removal: When the duration ends (surfaced from the water, left the spell's area).

terror.name: Terror
terror.system.description:
Effect: the only maneuver available is @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.Enl336RoHnl7foYR]{Interact}. Movement is allowed (it is not a maneuver), but each turn the bearer must move away from the source of the Terror.

Removal: When the duration ends, potions, spells.

Duration: 2 turns

withering.name: Withering
withering.system.description:
The flesh wastes away before your eyes: the muscle can't hold the swing, and the blow lands limp.

Effect: all of the bearer's damage drops by one step on the Damage Ladder (3d6 → 2d8 → 2d6 → 2d4 → 1d6 → 1d4; never below 1d4). The base formula of the weapon or maneuver shifts; additive bonuses to it are left alone.

Source: Shadowmancy, the Power Modifier (list 4, DC 16).

Duration: Doctrine Rank in rounds; 3 by default. The GM adjusts it to the caster's rank.
